name: sowduku-dev
description: Dev tooling for Sow-duku. The game itself is plain static HTML/JS and ships without any of this; the manifest exists only so CI (and a fresh machine) can install Playwright and run the browser suites. Playwright is pinned exactly, not caret-ranged, so a local install lands on the same browser build the sibling launcher checkout already downloaded — a floating range installs a version whose browsers aren't in the shared ms-playwright cache, and every suite fails on a missing executable.
